title: Runtime LTS (1.18) Backport Candidate Tracker — Patch 1.18.1-lts
content:
Sheet purpose
- Track candidate fixes to backport onto runtime-1.18-lts for the first patch (target: 1.18.1-lts).
- This is a working list; final inclusion is determined by LTS change management approvals + gates.

Legend / quick defs
- Risk score (1–5): 1=very low (docs/build-only or tiny targeted fix), 3=moderate (touches hot path but localized), 5=high (scheduler/kernel behavior changes, broad refactors).
- Eligibility: Security, Sev1 (crash/data loss), Sev2 (major correctness/perf), Supportability (observability / rollback), Release infra (reproducible artifacts).
- “Perf impact” notes are relative to 1.18.0 baseline. If “unknown” => perf-canary required before decision.

Current target patch
- Branch: runtime-1.18-lts
- Patch: 1.18.1-lts (RC window planned: week of 2025-03-10)

Columns
Candidate_ID | Title | Eligibility | Source PR (main) | Backport PR (lts) | Diff size | Risk (1-5) | Tests status | Perf-canary | Perf impact | Approvers (needed) | Target patch | Status | Notes

Notes / action items
- C-004 kernel autotune freeze: Marcus to post perf matrix snapshot (A100/H100/L40 + long/short mix) and call out any regressions >2% throughput or >1% p95.
- C-007 SBOM: waiting on CI secrets/permissions fix (INT-3302). If unresolved by RC-1 (2025-03-12), defer.
- If we include C-004, release notes must explicitly mention: “Autotune defaults pinned for stability; override available via config flag <TBD>.”

Approvals checklist (for each included backport)
- Runtime owner sign-off (Noah / relevant sub-lead)
- Release Eng sign-off (Connor)
- SRE sign-off (Sean or Rafael) if:
  - touches scheduling / overload handling OR
  - changes default perf-sensitive behavior OR
  - adds rollout/rollback steps
- Security sign-off (Hanae / Aisha) for any security patch or artifact/provenance changes

Last update summary (2025-03-18)
- Marked C-002 DONE after rerun on less-contended runners; waiver documented.
- Added conditional C-013 entry to ensure OOB process is pre-tracked.
- Added backlog placeholders (C-014/C-015) from pilot feedback to avoid losing context.
